Name: POSTURE_CONTROL_PARAM_GENDER_ST
Description: Body-type posture for the elbows and legs. Row ID = posture type × 100 + 0 for Body Type A or 1 for Body Type B; posture type is 0 normally, 1 while riding Torrent and 2 while in stealth (crouching). Each aNNN group is picked by the active weapon motion category (as in PostureControlParam_WepRight); categories without a group get no twist, and a missing row gives 0. Values are the maximum twist: the behaviour script scales them by a weight set by the current animation's TimeAct events and eases toward the result (up to 90 per second). Retail: the Body Type A rows are all 0.

Fields.Name: [a000] Right Elbow - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Right elbow inside/outside twist. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Left Elbow - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Left elbow inside/outside twist. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.

Fields.Name: [a000] Both Legs - Inside/Outside
Fields.Description: Inside/outside twist of both legs. Unlike the elbows, it isn't suppressed in some split upper/lower-body states and during jump attacks. Used when the active weapon motion category is 0. Twist amount; retail uses whole numbers. 0 is no twist.
